requirement: A Google or GitHub sign-in gives the account its provider photo, served by Tracy at /auth/avatar/:accountId

oracle.ref: PR #1094 (feat); fix evidence: PO 09/10/2026: 'my email already has an avatar everywhere, why is Tracy still showing a letter?' account.avatar_url was never written.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. exchangeCode returns the provider's name and picture (Google id_token claims with the profile scope, GitHub GET /user avatar_url). A later sign-in replaces the stored picture but never a display name already set. personFace answers /auth/avatar/?v=<8 hex> for a provider picture and null for any other host. GET /auth/avatar/:accountId: 401 without a session, 404 without a picture or for a non-provider address (never fetched), 200 image with ETag and private cache, 304 on If-None-Match, served from cache on the second read, 502 for non-image/SVG, over 1 MB, a redirect to another host, or a timeout. Face draws with the same-origin address.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

assertionIds: exchangeCode: google hands over the profile name and picture from the id_token
exchangeCode: github hands over the profile name and avatar_url from GET /user
memory-store mode: a later sign-in refreshes the picture and never overwrites a name already set
memory-store mode keeps the picture and name too, so /auth/me shows the photo without a database
avatarUrl: a stored provider picture is served through Tracy, never handed out as the provider address
avatarUrl: a stored address outside the picture hosts Tracy fetches from → null (the letter)
a signed-in viewer gets the picture: image bytes, a long private cache, an ETag, no sniffing
nobody signed in → 401, and the provider is never asked
an account with no picture, or no account at all → 404
a stored address outside the provider picture hosts is never fetched → 404
the second read is served from Tracy’s cache, and a matching If-None-Match answers 304
an answer that is not an image (or is SVG) → 502, nothing passed through
a picture over 1 MB → 502, whether or not the provider said its length
a redirect is followed only onto another provider picture host
a provider that does not answer in time → 502 (the module gives up on its own timeout)
a face whose photo is Tracy’s own picture address draws it as is, same origin
